title: Scheduler (node-cron worker)
summary: In-process node-cron background worker started from instrumentation.ts register() — nodejs-runtime-only, single-run guarded, try/catch-wrapped tick, env-overridable cadence + timezone. Opt-in alternative to an external/HTTP cron.

envVars.name: SCHEDULER_CRON
envVars.description: Cron expression for the job cadence. Defaults to '0 * * * *' (hourly on the hour).

envVars.name: SCHEDULER_TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for the schedule. Defaults to 'UTC'.

postInstall.description: Install the node-cron runtime dependency (shadcn installs it automatically from npmDependencies; run this if it did not).
Edit lib/scheduler-job.ts — replace the heartbeat body with your idempotent domain work.

Call startScheduler() from instrumentation.ts's register() under the NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs' guard. COMPOSE with the template's existing Sentry init (E293) — add the dynamic import + startScheduler() call alongside it; do NOT replace the file. See the install-scheduler skill for the exact edit.
Optionally set SCHEDULER_CRON and SCHEDULER_TZ in .env.local to override the hourly-UTC default.
